proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ N hN hc g hg
  haveI := hN
  have h1 : orderOf (g : G ⧸ N) ∣ Nat.card N := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (by rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, hg]; rfl)
  have h2 : orderOf (g : G ⧸ N) ∣ N.index := orderOf_dvd_natCard _
  have h3 := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hc h1 h2
  rw [orderOf_eq_one_iff] at h3
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).1 h3
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (N : Subgroup G), N.Normal → Nat.Coprime (Nat.card N) N.index → ∀ g : G, g ^ Nat.card N = 1 → g ∈ N
